description: This file is a script for orchestrating the execution of the 'tsgo' tool within a Node.js environment. It applies a custom policy to command-line arguments, manages locking mechanisms to ensure safe concurrent execution, and runs the 'tsgo' process via spawnSync, handling errors and cleanup.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Applies custom processing to command-line arguments and environment variables for the 'tsgo' execution.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Obtains a lock to prevent concurrent heavy checks, ensuring safe, serialized execution.
